entities.summary: Jorma Kalevi "Pilkku" Pilkevaara was a Finnish professional basketball player. During his playing career, he was listed at 1.88 m tall, and 86 kg (190 lb). He was elected to the Finnish Basketball Hall of Fame, in 2013.
